text: dsh-charlotte 是面向 DSH Web 的技能管理与推荐插件。它在侧边栏和设置页提供技能启动器，并接入对话输入区的推荐卡；宿主端注册统一技能来源和本地 API，记录实际调用以支持推荐。插件默认只读挂载 Claude Code、Codex、ZCode、Cursor 与 Gemini 技能目录，并监视目录变化；启动器可浏览和管理技能，按当前对话展示候选，再由用户选择加载。适合希望在 DSH 中集中查找、整理和调用多来源技能的用户。代码未显示需要 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-charlotte is a DSH Web skill manager with a sidebar launcher and conversation recommendation card. It mounts Claude Code, Codex, ZCode, Cursor, and Gemini skill folders as a provider, watches for changes, and observes skill use for recommendations. Users can browse skills and choose suggestions.

dsh-charlotte 的技能启动器：在侧边栏入口或设置页打开技能界面，并在对话输入区提供推荐卡。用户可从统一界面查看技能，也能查看当前对话的推荐并选择使用。
dsh-charlotte 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 13 天；提交数 3；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

dsh-charlotte README · dsh-charlotte：[English](README.en.md) | 中文

装在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 里的技能启动器与技能库。

`dsh-charlotte` 只占一个「dsh-charlotte」入口：数据驱动的技能管理页（紧凑列表、真实功能分类、常用与收藏、右侧详情抽屉）、宿主侧实时推荐，以及「授权 → 加载 → 执行」全链路状态反馈。外部 Claude Code / Codex / ZCode / Cursor / Gemini 技能目录以只读方式挂载成一个 dsh 技能来源；启用、安装、删除与回收站能力都保留。

dsh-charlotte README · 安装：桌面应用：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件 → 安装第三方插件，填 `https://github.com/AlpFallen/dsh-charlotte`（该入口同样接受 npm 包名和本地目录），装完重启应用，侧边栏设置按钮上方会出现「dsh-charlotte」入口。桌面 profile 由 App 托管，CLI 的 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add` 会被拒绝（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。

命令行（web profile）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AlpFallen/dsh-charlotte
```

dsh-charlotte README · 安装：本机运行环境是桌面 App 内置的 DSH `0.2.1-rc.3`（Node `24.21.0`），本插件在这套环境上加载运行，下面的截图也来自它；另外用 CLI 安装的 DSH `0.1.5-rc.2` 做过接口比对。宿主接口（`webServer.register` 的 `WebRoute`、`agent/pre-step` waterfall、`ctx.skills`）两版形状一致；客户端槽位（`conversation.input.dock`）在 0.2 里改过契约（`PropsRenderFactories`、草稿编辑器拆分），0.2.1-rc.3 上界面可用，更新的 0.2.x 版本未验证。

仓库里带着编译好的客户端产物（`client/client.js`），从 GitHub 安装不需要构建。本地开发时克隆后把 profile 依赖改成 `"link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-charlotte"` 再 `pnpm install`，然后重启应用。

dsh-charlotte README · 功能：- **单一入口** — 侧栏只有「dsh-charlotte」一个入口。作用域、拖拽安装、回收站、刷新和语言收进 **更多** 菜单。
- **常用与收藏** — 首页顶部先给置顶、再给收藏、最后按真实调用频率补足（最多 4 条）；没有数据时整块不渲染，不编造示例。
- **真实功能分类** — 开发工作、代码质量、项目理解、文档与知识、任务协作、设计与创作、办公文档、邮件沟通、学习教练；每个技能归到哪一类由它自己的名称/描述/触发条件计算，详情里给出命中依据；没有「其他」类，零计数类不显示。
- **紧凑列表 + 侧边详情** — 行内是名称与版本、完整描述、可用状态、来源、收藏/置顶、使用、详情；详情走右侧抽屉，含推荐理由、适用/排除场景、触发条件、权限、依赖、版本、来源路径、真实使用记录与字段来源。
- **搜索、筛选、排序** — 搜索覆盖名称、描述、用途、关键词、触发条件与分类；可按分类、来源（项目级/用户专属/插件提供/系统内置）、状态筛选；排序只有调用频率、名称、最近使用——没有真实下载时间，所以不提供下载时间排序。
- **一次点击加载** — 点击 **使用** 后先在宿主校验（是否可见、是否启用、依赖是否满足），再把官方 `/技能名` token 放进当前或新建对话的输入框。不会发送消息、不会启动 Agent 回合；只有你发送后才注入技能指令。加载中再点一次即取消，失败显示宿主给出的真实原因。
- **如实的停用语义** — 对模型停用但用户可调用的技能仍然可用，并标记为「仅用户」；用户不可调用的技能不能使用。
- **插件自带技能** — 由 dsh 插件或 bundled provider 注册的技能现在也会以只读的 `插件` 卡片出现在同一网格里，带 provider 标签、只读详情和同样的 **使用技能** 加载流程。技能站只负责展示与加载，不能启停或删除；文件归提供它的插件所有。列表随 `/skills.registry` 返回，详情读 `/registry-skill`。
- **挂载外部技能** — 只读 provider 把 `~/.claude/skills`、`~/.codex/skills`、`~/.zcode/skills`、`~/.cursor/skills`、`~/.gemini/skills`（含 `~/.gemini/antigravity/skills`）、各工作区的 `.claude|.codex|.zcode|.cursor|.gemini/skills` 以及自定义 `extraDirs` 注册成 dsh 技能来源。文件原地不动：frontmatter 字段映射（`disable-model-invocation`、`user-invocable

dsh-charlotte README · 实时推荐：宿主在 `agent/pre-step` 用你本轮的原文（以及它在真实技能元数据上的匹配结果）评估候选，把结果停在宿主侧；客户端等这轮回答结束（running 真→假）后才在输入框上方展示推荐卡。因此推荐不会打断生成，也不会把「推荐」当成「加载」。

- 流程：快速筛选（未启用/用户不可调用/依赖缺失直接排除）→ 语义匹配（中英 token + 双语同义词桥接 + 触发条件/关键词/描述字段加权）→ 相关度排序 → 权限与依赖检查 → 推荐。
- 价值门槛：寒暄、简单问答、过短提示不推荐；默认只推最相关的 1 个，第二/第三个必须接近最高分（`comboRatio`）且不重复功能。
- 去重与打扰控制：同一任务不重复推同一技能；「忽略」后本次任务不再出现，只有需求实质变化才重新评估；冷却时间、每会话次数、阈值都可配置。
- 卡片只显示名称、用途摘要、推荐原因与 **使用 / 忽略**；点「使用」走与管理页相同的授权加载链路。

dsh-charlotte README · 「加载」到底做了什么：DSH 没有 per-Session Skill attachment，也没有不产生模型回合就能注入技能指令的宿主 API。受支持的非执行准备方式就是官方的 `/name` composer token：加载会把 `/技能名 ` 放进目标对话的输入框，然后关闭启动器。不会发送消息、不会启动 Agent 回合、不会插入隐藏用户消息。你输入自己的任务并发送时，宿主才把 token 转成技能指令；发送前把 token 删掉，技能就不会生效。

状态是分阶段的：发现 → 推荐 → 待确认 → 加载中 → 已加载 → 执行中 → 成功 / 失败 / 已取消。「已加载」只代表输入框里确实有 token；「执行中」必须是宿主在 pre-step 真的看到技能指令注入；「成功」是注入过技能的回合正常结束。失败时展示真实原因（权限不足、依赖缺失、输入框忙、服务缺失），不伪造成功。

dsh-charlotte README · 配置：均可选，写在 profile 补丁层的 `dsh-charlotte` 插件行下；未知键启动即报错。

```yaml
plugins:
  dsh-charlotte:
    sources:
      claude: true                      # ~/.claude/skills + <project>/.claude/skills

dsh-charlotte README · 安全模型：- 技能写入只落在上述可写根目录，以及 dsh-charlotte 自己的状态目录 `~/.dsh/charlotte/`；每个路径在规范化后做包含性检查，复制不跟随 symlink，上传拒绝路径穿越。
- 外部 agent 目录只读挂载；开关状态存在 dsh-charlotte 的覆盖表里，不写回它们的 `SKILL.md`。
- 变更类 HTTP 接口拒绝跨源请求；API 与 GUI 同一本地服务。
- 加载/启停/收藏都在服务端复核：`/use` 重新检查可见性、启用状态与依赖；`loaded` 事件只接受刚被授权的会话；前端展示不替代权限检查。
- 技能使用授权不等于具体操作授权：删除文件、发送消息、提交数据等高风险动作仍由 DSH 工具权限与审批独立校验。
- 挂载与上传的技能都是第三方内容，启用前请先审阅。

A skill launcher and skill hub inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

dsh-charlotte README · dsh-charlotte：`dsh-charlotte` gives the Harness one focused launcher entry: an index-driven management page (compact list, evidence-based functional categories, pinned/frequent strip, right-side detail drawer), host-side live recommendations, and a full authorize -> load -> execute state chain. External Claude Code / Codex / ZCode / Cursor / Gemini skill directories are mounted read-only as one dsh skill source, and enable, install, delete and trash management stay available.

dsh-charlotte README · Install：In the desktop app: Settings -> Plugins -> Add plugin -> Install a third-party plugin, enter `https://github.com/AlpFallen/dsh-charlotte` (the same dialog accepts npm package names and local directories), restart, and the dsh-charlotte button appears above Settings in the sidebar. The desktop profile is owned by the Electron app, so the CLI refuses `dsh plugin --profile desktop add` with `profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`.

dsh-charlotte README · What you get：- **One dsh-charlotte entry** — the sidebar button opens the launcher. Secondary administration lives under **More**: scope, drag-and-drop install, recycle bin, refresh and language.
- **Pinned & frequent** — the top strip shows pinned skills first, then favourites, then the most-used skills (real counters, at most four). With no data the strip is not rendered at all; no sample rows are invented.
- **Evidence-based categories** — Development, Code Quality, Project Understanding, Docs & Knowledge, Task Collaboration, Design & Creation, Office Documents, Mail & Communication, Learning & Coaching. Which category a skill lands in is computed from its own name, description and triggers, and the matching terms are shown in the detail panel. There is no "other" bucket, and empty categories are not rendered.
- **Compact list + side panel** — each row carries name and real version, the full description, availability, source, favourite/pin controls, Use and Details. Details open in a right-side drawer: why it was recommended, use/avoid cases, triggers, permissions, dependencies, version, source path, real usage history and field provenance.

dsh-charlotte README · Live recommendations：The host evaluates candidates at `agent/pre-step` from your actual prompt and the real skill metadata, and parks the result host-side. The client only asks for it after the turn settles (`running` true -> false), so the card appears above the composer when the answer is finished and never interrupts generation. Recommendation is never treated as loading.

dsh-charlotte README · Live recommendations：- Pipeline: quick filter (disabled / not user-invocable / missing dependency are dropped) -> semantic match (CJK and Latin tokens plus a small bilingual synonym bridge, weighted trigger/keyword/description fields) -> ranking -> permission and dependency check -> recommendation.
- Value gate: small talk, simple Q&A and very short prompts produce nothing. One candidate is the default; a second or third must be close to the top score (`comboRatio`) and must not duplicate the same function.
- De-duplication: the same skill is not re-offered for the same task; Ignore suppresses it until the need materially changes; cooldown, per-session frequency and thresholds are configurable.
- The card shows only name, category, reason and Use / Ignore. Use runs the same authorized load chain as the management page.

dsh-charlotte README · How "load" works：DSH has no per-Session Skill attachment and no host API that loads instructions without a model turn. The supported non-executing preparation is the official `/name` composer token: loading stages `/skill-name ` in the target conversation's input and closes the launcher. No message is sent, no Agent turn starts, and no hidden user message is inserted. When you type your task and send, the host turns the token into the Skill instructions. If you clear the token before sending, the Skill is not applied.

dsh-charlotte README · How "load" works：States are staged separately: discovered -> recommended -> pending confirmation -> loading -> loaded -> executing -> succeeded / failed / cancelled. "Loaded" only means the token is really in the composer; "executing" requires the host to observe the skill instructions entering the request at pre-step; "succeeded" means that turn finished normally. Failures show the real reason (permission, missing dependency, busy composer, missing service) and never fake success.

dsh-charlotte README · Security model：- Skill writes only ever land inside the writable roots above plus the station's own state (`~/.dsh/charlotte/`); every path is containment-checked after normalization, symlinks are never followed during copies, and uploads reject traversal segments.
- External agent directories are mounted read-only; the switch state lives in the station's override file, not in their `SKILL.md`.
- Mutating HTTP endpoints reject cross-origin requests; the API is served on the same local server as the GUI.
- Load, enable and favourite are re-checked server-side: `/use` re-validates visibility, enablement and dependencies; a `loaded` event is only accepted for a session that was just authorized. Front-end display never replaces a permission check.
- Skill usage authorization is not operation authorization: deleting files, sending messages or submitting data still go through DSH tool permissions and approval independently.
- Mounted and uploaded skills are third-party content — review them before enabling.
